text: {"1243":{"about":["rustc_type_ir"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"The type IR represents the semantic `str` type using the `Str` variant, while `str` is source syntax."},"1244":{"about":["rustc_type_ir"],"refers":[],"why":"The type IR's `Slice` variant represents slice types."},"1245":{"about":["rustc_type_ir"],"refers":[],"why":"The type IR's `Array` variant represents fixed-size array types."},"1246":{"about":["rustc_type_ir"],"refers":[],"why":"The type IR's `RawPtr` variant represents mutable and immutable raw pointer types."},"1247":{"about":["rustc_type_ir"],"refers":[],"why":"The type IR's `Ref` variant represents safe shared and mutable reference types."}}
